_doc: Banked counts of hand-rolled <table>/<Table> RENDER SITES per app, and DataGrid adoption. Written by scripts/check-airtable-grid-adoption.mjs --update-baseline. Fails on any RISE (a new hand-rolled table is a page someone must convert later) and on any UNBANKED FALL (so a matcher that goes blind cannot read as progress). Operator ask 2026-08-28: every table should be in the Airtable style.
_clickThroughDoc: Files that HAD row-level click-through to a record. Recorded by PATH because a conversion destroys the <TableRow onClick> evidence. Any file here that renders a DataGrid must pass onRowClick, or the conversion turned a working navigation into a dead list. Operator ask 2026-08-28: "make sure table that currently enable click through to a record still maintain this capability." The set is a UNION and only grows.

exceptions.reason: Browses any of 84 catalogued entities dynamically; a row's shape and identity change with the operator's entity selection, so there is no single fixed detail route a click could resolve to. The interaction model IS in-grid cell editing ("click a cell, change it, undo it"), not row navigation to elsewhere.

Catalog-driven report builder over 20 entities, 199 fields, 34 joins; a result row can be a grouped/aggregated projection across joined entities with no single backing record, so there is structurally no fixed destination to navigate to.

Shared paginated results table for W2 template-driven reports; rows are whatever the selected report template projects (same polymorphic-row reasoning as ReportBuilder), so no fixed detail route exists.

Append-only compliance log (create-only mutation, no update path anywhere in the app); no per-registration detail page exists anywhere, and every field the record has is already visible in the row itself.

Every row action (advance/suspend/terminate/transfer) is served by an explicit transition-dialog button already in the row; this table never had click-through even before its DataGrid conversion, and the transition dialog IS the record's interaction surface.

A row is a synthetic aggregate -- a distinct tag NAME derived from a Set across all contacts' free-text tags -- not a persisted record with its own id or detail page. The only action is delete, already served by the row's own action column.

Read-only audit trail of super-admin tenant-switch EVENTS (crm7#1153); a switch event is an immutable historical fact fully represented by its row with no per-event detail page anywhere, and every column is editable:false.

_schedule.unit: hand-rolled <table>/<Table> RENDER SITES (sum of apps.*.handRolled), not files; per_week is render sites per week
